newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris air cargo emergency committee activated.
newsitem.headline: Paris air cargo emergency committee activated.

text.p: The air cargo community at Paris' Charles de Gaulle airport has activated an emergency sub-committee to keep the industry informed of the impact of labour disputes there this week, said the Comite Interprofessionel du Fret (CIF) which represents the industry at the airport.

CIF said the new commitee was relaying information to forwarders and airlines on the impact of industrial action by Aeroports de Paris (ADP) and Air France Cargo workers Wednesday as well as a strike planned for Thursday by air traffic controllers.

"While the CIF as a body had not officially created the emergency committee, the course of events decreed that we activate it as soon as possible," an ADP freight department official told Reuters. Before this week's developments the new committee had been due to be formally created on Friday.

"Our aim is to keep the air cargo community abreast of developments and to propose contingency plans where appropriate. One member of the emergency committee liaises with forwarders and another with the airlines," the official said.
A strike Wednesday by ADP workers has affected some ramp handling services for freight while work-to-rule action at Air France Cargo had disrupted the flow of traffic at its CDG hub, he added.
